posts.title: Handwritten code
posts.description: But what a privilege it is to read your code. I like that I can tell how it was worked out, with the occasional detritus of paths that were started and scrapped but imperfectly scrubbed over. I adore reading comments telling me what you were thinking about. I know you spent fifteen minutes figuring it out and you were kind enough to report on it, like leaving a trail marker as a quiet guiding hand
